entries.title: Acronyms (Chapter Glossary)
do_not_test: Acronym list itself - reference material only.
entries.zero_question_reason: Pure glossary/reference content, no clinical competency to assess.

entries.title: Cardiac Anatomy Review

testable_competencies.interpretation: Correlate coronary artery territory with ECG lead distribution to localize ischemia (supports SU-C-09, SU-C-21).

do_not_test: Detailed embryologic/histologic cardiac anatomy not required for clinical decision-making.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's own causal_conditions list names 'Acute coronary syndromes', 'Stable angina pectoris', 'Pericarditis' explicitly; enabling objectives explicitly require ECG, CXR, labs, and differentiating cardiac from noncardiac pain.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize chest pain presentations requiring urgent cardiac workup vs. lower-risk presentations.
testable_competencies.differential: Differentiate cardiac (ACS, pericarditis, aortic dissection) from noncardiac (GI, musculoskeletal, pulmonary, psychiatric) causes.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select initial investigations (ECG, troponin, CXR) appropriate to clinical probability.
testable_competencies.emergency: Identify red-flag features requiring immediate stabilization and urgent referral.

entries.title: Syncope and Loss of Consciousness (Cardiac Differential)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly list cardiac arrhythmia, aortic stenosis/reduced cardiac output, and cerebrovascular causes; enabling objectives explicitly require ECG/echocardiogram and differentiating syncope from seizure.

testable_competencies.recognition: Distinguish syncope from seizure and other transient loss-of-consciousness mimics.
testable_competencies.differential: Identify cardiac (arrhythmic, structural) vs. reflex vs. orthostatic causes.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select appropriate initial workup (ECG, orthostatic vitals, echocardiogram where indicated).
testable_competencies.emergency: Recognize high-risk features (exertional syncope, structural heart disease, family history of sudden death) requiring urgent evaluation.

entries.title: Peripheral/Local Edema

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Registry causal_conditions for localized edema are predominantly venous/lymphatic (DVT, lymphedema, cellulitis) rather than primary cardiac; cardiac contribution is indirect. Classified DIRECT because the objective itself covers the presentation Toronto Notes addresses here, but see cross-discipline note.

testable_competencies.recognition: Distinguish unilateral/localized edema from systemic cardiac edema.
testable_competencies.differential: Recognize DVT as a must-not-miss cause requiring urgent evaluation.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Primary content ownership arguably Medicine/Vascular Surgery (DVT-driven differential) rather than Cardiology; included here because Toronto Notes places it in the Cardiology differential-diagnosis section.

entries.title: Generalized Edema

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly list 'Heart failure' as a named cause; enabling objectives require differentiating systemic from local edema and categorizing the mechanism.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize generalized edema as a sign of volume overload.
testable_competencies.differential: Differentiate cardiac (heart failure) from renal, hepatic, and other systemic causes.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select investigations to establish the mechanism (e.g., BNP, echocardiogram, renal/liver panel).

entries.cross_discipline_note: Shared ownership with Nephrology (renal causes) - see cross_discipline_map.json (future work).

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly list atrial fibrillation/flutter, SVT (AVNRT, WPW), junctional tachycardia, PACs/PJCs, ventricular tachycardia; enabling objectives require ECG and rhythm-focused investigation.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize palpitations warranting urgent vs. non-urgent evaluation based on hemodynamic stability.
testable_competencies.differential: Differentiate benign (anxiety, caffeine, PACs) from arrhythmic causes.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select appropriate rhythm-monitoring strategy (resting ECG vs. ambulatory monitoring) based on symptom frequency.

entries.title: Dyspnea (Cardiac Differential)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly list myocardial dysfunction/heart failure, valvular heart disease, pericardial disease, and arrhythmia as cardiac causes; enabling objectives require determining whether dyspnea is cardiac, pulmonary, or other.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize dyspnea presentations requiring urgent assessment (ABCs).
testable_competencies.differential: Differentiate cardiac from pulmonary and other causes of dyspnea.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select initial investigations (ECG, CXR, ABG, BNP where relevant).
testable_competencies.emergency: Initiate emergent management for acute cardiogenic dyspnea.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Shared ownership with Respirology for pulmonary causes; this unit covers the cardiac-differential slice only.

entries.title: ECG Interpretation Fundamentals

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'electrocardiograms (ECGs)' as a critical investigation.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'electrocardiography...to assess cardiac rhythm'.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'electrocardiography' as a critical investigation.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'electrocardiogram' with particular attention to diagnosing rhythm disturbances.

testable_competencies.interpretation: Systematically interpret a 12-lead ECG (rate, rhythm, axis, intervals, ST/T changes) to identify ischemia, arrhythmia, and conduction abnormalities.

do_not_test: Detailed electrophysiologic mechanism derivations beyond pattern recognition.

entries.title: Cardiac Biomarker Interpretation

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives name 'appropriate laboratory tests' generically for chest pain workup; troponin/biomarkers not named by name in the objective text, so mapping strength is MODERATE rather than STRONG.

testable_competencies.interpretation: Interpret serial troponin results in the context of clinical probability of ACS.

do_not_test: Assay-specific analytic detail (high-sensitivity vs. conventional assay technical specifications).

entries.title: Echocardiography and Advanced Cardiac Imaging

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'echocardiography' as an investigation to determine underlying causes of arrhythmia.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'echocardiogram' with attention to structural/functional cardiac disturbance.

testable_competencies.investigation: Recognize indications for echocardiography (structural/functional assessment, valve disease, ejection fraction).
testable_competencies.interpretation: Interpret basic echocardiographic findings (ejection fraction category, gross valve/chamber abnormality) in clinical context.

do_not_test: Detailed echocardiographic Doppler measurement technique.
Cardiac MRI protocol selection or detailed sequence interpretation - recognize as an advanced/specialist modality only.

entries.title: Exercise/Pharmacologic Stress Testing

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives explicitly name 'identifying, as appropriate, patients for additional investigations (e.g., stress testing, imaging)'.

testable_competencies.investigation: Recognize appropriate candidates for stress testing (intermediate-probability stable chest pain) and contraindications.

do_not_test: Specific stress protocol selection technical detail (treadmill protocol variants, pharmacologic agent pharmacokinetics).

entries.title: Cardiac Catheterization and Coronary Angiography

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Implied by 'additional investigations' enabling text and by its role as the confirmatory investigation preceding revascularization decisions (SU-C-22); not explicitly named 'catheterization' or 'angiography' in the objective text itself.

testable_competencies.investigation: Recognize indications for cardiac catheterization (confirming CAD, guiding revascularization decisions).

do_not_test: Catheterization technique, access-site selection, contrast agent pharmacology.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: 'disturbances of cardiac rhythm and function' named generically as a syncope cause; bradyarrhythmia not individually named.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize symptomatic bradyarrhythmia (sinus node dysfunction, AV block) on ECG.
testable_competencies.emergency: Identify hemodynamically unstable bradycardia requiring urgent intervention.

entries.title: Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome / Pre-Excitation

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome' by name.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize the WPW ECG pattern (short PR, delta wave).
testable_competencies.initial_management: Recognize the need to avoid AV-nodal blocking agents in WPW-associated tachyarrhythmia.

do_not_test: Detailed accessory pathway electrophysiology.

entries.title: Supraventricular Tachyarrhythmias

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter', 'Supraventricular tachycardia (atrioventricular nodal re-entrant tachycardia...)', 'Junctional tachycardia', 'Premature atrial contractions and premature junctional complexes'.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize atrial fibrillation/flutter and other SVTs on ECG.
testable_competencies.initial_management: Determine rate vs. rhythm control strategy and anticoagulation need (CHADS-65/CHA2DS2-VASc reasoning) for atrial fibrillation.
testable_competencies.emergency: Manage hemodynamically unstable SVT/AFib (urgent cardioversion indication).

do_not_test: Detailed catheter ablation technique - recognize as a management option only.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Ventricular tachycardia' under the Ventricular category.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize monomorphic/polymorphic VT on ECG and distinguish from SVT with aberrancy.
testable_competencies.emergency: Initiate emergency management of pulseless and pulsed VT.

entries.title: Cardiac Arrest / Sudden Cardiac Death

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective title and causal_conditions (coronary artery disease, conduction abnormalities, myocardial abnormalities) directly match this study unit.

testable_competencies.emergency: Initiate basic and advanced cardiac life support for cardiac arrest.
testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize shockable vs. non-shockable rhythms.

do_not_test: Detailed ACLS drug dosing intervals beyond recognizing the algorithm structure.
clinical_source_organizations: Heart and Stroke Foundation of Canada (resuscitation guidelines)

entries.title: Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices (Pacemakers and ICDs)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: ICDs are a secondary-prevention device for cardiac arrest survivors; not explicitly named in the objective text. Weak/indirect evidence - flagged for review.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Device therapy is a downstream management consideration once arrhythmic syncope is diagnosed; not explicitly named.

testable_competencies.initial_management: Recognize clinical indications for pacemaker (symptomatic bradycardia/heart block) and ICD (post-arrest survivors, reduced ejection fraction) placement.

do_not_test: Device programming, lead placement technique, implantation procedure.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Stable angina pectoris' by name.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize the classic presentation and risk-factor profile of stable angina.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select appropriate outpatient investigation pathway (stress testing vs. angiography based on risk).

entries.title: Acute Coronary Syndromes

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Acute coronary syndromes'; enabling objectives explicitly name 'initiating appropriate therapies in urgent situations (e.g., acute coronary syndrome...)'.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize STEMI/NSTEMI/unstable angina presentations and ECG patterns.
testable_competencies.investigation: Interpret serial ECG and troponin trends to risk-stratify ACS.
testable_competencies.initial_management: Initiate immediate ACS management (antiplatelet/anticoagulant therapy, urgent reperfusion pathway activation).
testable_competencies.emergency: Recognize STEMI requiring emergent reperfusion (PCI/fibrinolysis pathway activation).
testable_competencies.complications: Recognize and manage early post-MI complications (arrhythmia, mechanical complications, heart failure).

do_not_test: Exact fibrinolytic agent dosing.
Detailed PCI technique.

entries.title: Coronary Revascularization (PCI vs CABG)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Enabling objectives name 'referring for urgent specialized care as required'; revascularization modality choice itself not explicitly named in objective text.

testable_competencies.initial_management: Recognize clinical scenarios favouring PCI vs. CABG (e.g., left main/multivessel disease, diabetes, surgical candidacy) at a conceptual level.

do_not_test: Detailed surgical technique.
Graft selection specifics.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Heart failure'.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Myocardial dysfunction (e.g., ischemic cardiomyopathy, heart failure)'.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize signs/symptoms of decompensated heart failure (volume overload, reduced perfusion).
testable_competencies.investigation: Interpret BNP/NT-proBNP and echocardiographic ejection fraction in context.
testable_competencies.initial_management: Initiate guideline-directed medical therapy principles and manage acute decompensation.
testable_competencies.complications: Recognize complications of chronic heart failure (arrhythmia, renal dysfunction, cardiorenal syndrome).

entries.title: Cardio-Oncology

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize that certain chemotherapy agents (e.g., anthracyclines, trastuzumab) carry cardiotoxic risk requiring monitoring.

do_not_test: Detailed cardio-oncology surveillance protocols and specific agent-by-agent toxicity thresholds.

entries.title: Myocarditis

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: 'Myocardial dysfunction' named generically in causal_conditions; myocarditis specifically not named by name.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize myocarditis presentation (often post-viral, chest pain/dyspnea with elevated troponin and normal coronaries).
testable_competencies.complications: Recognize risk of arrhythmia and fulminant heart failure in myocarditis.

do_not_test: Endomyocardial biopsy technique and histopathologic classification.

entries.title: Cardiomyopathies (Dilated, Hypertrophic, Restrictive)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'ischemic cardiomyopathy' as an example of myocardial dysfunction; dilated/hypertrophic/restrictive cardiomyopathy are the standard differential taught under this same causal category.

testable_competencies.differential: Differentiate dilated, hypertrophic, and restrictive cardiomyopathy by history, exam, and echocardiographic findings.
testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize hypertrophic cardiomyopathy as a cause of exertional syncope/sudden death in young patients.
testable_competencies.complications: Recognize arrhythmia and heart failure as shared complications across cardiomyopathy subtypes.

do_not_test: Left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy - rare subtype, recognition of existence only, not detailed diagnostic criteria.
Genetic testing panel selection.

entries.title: Advanced Heart Failure Therapies (Transplant, VAD, ECMO)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Downstream escalation of refractory heart failure management (heart failure named in this objective's causal_conditions); transplant/VAD/ECMO decision-making itself not addressed in the objective text.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize that transplant, VAD, and ECMO are escalation options for refractory heart failure/cardiogenic shock.

do_not_test: Transplant candidacy criteria detail.
VAD device selection.
ECMO circuit management.

entries.title: Cardiac Tumours

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Cardiac tumours (e.g., atrial myxoma) can present with obstructive syncope or embolic phenomena; not explicitly named in any reviewed objective.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize atrial myxoma as a rare cause of positional syncope, embolic events, or constitutional symptoms with a mobile mass on echocardiography.

do_not_test: Detailed tumour histopathology.

entries.title: Valvular Heart Disease (Stenotic and Regurgitant Lesions)

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective title and causal_conditions directly name S1/S2/S3/S4 abnormalities, systolic murmurs (aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation), and diastolic murmurs - i.e., the major valve lesions this study unit covers.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize the auscultatory findings of major stenotic and regurgitant valve lesions.
testable_competencies.investigation: Select echocardiography as the confirmatory investigation for suspected valve disease.
testable_competencies.complications: Recognize heart failure and arrhythmia as complications of untreated valve disease.

entries.title: Infective Endocarditis

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Infective endocarditis is a classic cause of new/changing murmurs and a recognized complication of valve disease; not explicitly named in the objective's shown causal_conditions text (list marked 'not exhaustive').

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize clinical features (fever, new murmur, embolic phenomena) suggesting infective endocarditis.
testable_competencies.investigation: Apply modified Duke criteria conceptually (blood cultures, echocardiography).
testable_competencies.initial_management: Recognize indications for antibiotic prophylaxis in at-risk patients undergoing procedures.

do_not_test: Detailed antibiotic regimen selection and duration.

entries.title: Rheumatic Fever

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Rheumatic fever is a recognized cause of chronic valve disease (mitral stenosis); not explicitly named in the objective's causal_conditions text.

testable_competencies.recognition: Apply Jones criteria conceptually to recognize acute rheumatic fever.
testable_competencies.prevention_followup: Recognize the rationale for secondary antibiotic prophylaxis to prevent recurrence and valve damage.

entries.cross_discipline_note: Shares ownership with Pediatrics (rheumatic fever is classically a pediatric/young-adult presentation).

entries.title: Valve Intervention: Repair/Replacement and Prosthetic Management

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's key_objectives require initiating 'an appropriate management plan' once valve disease is diagnosed; specific prosthesis-choice/intervention-timing detail not named in the objective text.

testable_competencies.initial_management: Recognize indications for valve intervention (severe symptomatic disease, declining ventricular function).
testable_competencies.prevention_followup: Recognize anticoagulation requirements differ between mechanical and bioprosthetic valves.

do_not_test: Surgical valve repair/replacement technique.
Detailed prosthesis engineering comparison.

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Pericarditis' by name.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize the classic pleuritic, positional chest pain and ECG findings (diffuse ST elevation, PR depression) of acute pericarditis.
testable_competencies.initial_management: Initiate anti-inflammatory therapy and recognize when to investigate for underlying cause.

entries.title: Pericardial Effusion and Cardiac Tamponade

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Objective's causal_conditions explicitly name 'Pericardial disease (e.g., tamponade, pericarditis)'.

testable_competencies.recognition: Recognize clinical/echocardiographic signs of tamponade physiology (Beck's triad, pulsus paradoxus, echo findings).
testable_competencies.emergency: Recognize tamponade as an emergency requiring urgent pericardiocentesis.

do_not_test: Pericardiocentesis procedural technique.

entries.title: Constrictive Pericarditis

mcc_evidence.official_source: research/mcc/objectives_registry.json (retrieved from official MCC Objectives Online Web Service)
mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Covered only generically under 'Pericardial disease' in causal_conditions; constrictive pericarditis not individually named.

testable_competencies.differential: Differentiate constrictive pericarditis from restrictive cardiomyopathy conceptually.

do_not_test: Detailed hemodynamic catheterization tracings.

entries.title: Cardiopulmonary Bypass (Extracorporeal Circulation)
do_not_test: Cardiopulmonary bypass circuit management, cardioplegia technique, cerebral protection strategy during bypass - all beyond graduating medical student scope.
entries.zero_question_reason: Operative/perfusion technical detail beyond expected graduating-medical-student depth (see task's explicit exclusion examples: detailed operative technique, specialist procedural measurements).
